site.heroTagline: The creative mind behind intelligent digital experiences
aboutParas: I am Rashi Sharma, a digital marketing specialist from Pundri, learning to harness the power of Artificial Intelligence. I believe technology and marketing, when combined with creativity, can build experiences people remember.

I completed my schooling in Pundri - finishing 10th in 2023 and 12th in 2024. Then I successfully completed my NIELIT O Level course, where I mastered essential programming languages including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, IoT and C++. I am currently pursuing a Digital Marketing with AI course to bring intelligent, data-driven strategies to brands.
Beyond studies, I love building things. I have designed websites and developed games that turn ideas into working, interactive products - every project is a chance to learn, create and grow.
site.aboutHighlight: Technology is my canvas, and marketing is my voice - I create work that people remember.
visionSlides: I don't chase trends. I create value.
I don't build projects. I build experiences.
I don't just market. I make brands unforgettable.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.intro: I didn't stop at just learning - I applied everything. From writing my first lines of code in O Level to building complete websites and games, my journey has been powered by curiosity and a habit of turning knowledge into creation.

items.text: Completed my Class 10th - this is where I discovered my love for technology.
Completed my Class 12th and began exploring computers and programming seriously.
Completed my NIELIT O Level - mastering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, IoT and C++.
